headlines.title: Broncos suspend Dobbins for the Steelers game
headlines.summary: Sean Payton said Tuesday that running back J.K. Dobbins is suspended for Friday's game in Pittsburgh for conduct detrimental to the team. Dobbins won't practise or take part in team activities this week, and Payton declined to give details. Dobbins had one carry, for no gain, in Denver's 38–24 win over the Raiders. Payton says the Broncos will have depth at running back.
headlines.whyItMatters: Denver are 8–2 and the AFC's No. 2 seed, so the Broncos need their backfield to hold up while Dobbins is out. He was one of the team's priorities to re-sign this offseason.

headlines.title: DeVito starts for the Patriots while Maye recovers
headlines.summary: Drake Maye fractured his right fibula in New England's loss to Detroit in Germany on Nov. 15 and is expected to be out at least six weeks. Tommy DeVito is the starter. The Patriots (5–5) come off a bye and visit the 1–9 Chargers on Sunday. Coach Mike Vrabel hopes Maye can return this season, but it's no guarantee.
headlines.whyItMatters: New England are 1.0 game back of the final AFC playoff spot, so their chances hinge on how DeVito plays.

headlines.title: Giants beat Jaguars to climb the NFC
headlines.summary: The Giants beat the Jaguars 23–18 on Sunday. New York are now 6–3–1 and third in the NFC playoff picture. Yahoo's power rankings now treat them as a real contender. Greg Newsome II is out 4 to 6 weeks, so Paulson Adebo is back in a starting role.
headlines.whyItMatters: Beating a 7–3 Jaguars team boosts the Giants' hopes of winning the NFC East and making a run in the conference.

teamNews.text: The Raiders lost 38–24 at Denver in Week 11 and have lost three straight. They are 10th in the AFC, 2.5 games behind the last playoff spot. Fernando Mendoza, in his second NFL start, is settling in as the starter.

headlines.title: Kawhi Leonard starts individual on-court workouts
headlines.summary: Kawhi Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts after treatment for swelling in his left knee. He played two games before the injury, averaging 19.5 points. The Raptors will provide another update in one week, and ESPN reports his return is at least a week away.
headlines.whyItMatters: Toronto are 6–11 and 10th in the East.

headlines.title: Jalen Duren nears return from hamstring strain
headlines.summary: Pistons centre Jalen Duren practised with the team on Tuesday and begins a rehab assignment with the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday. He hurt his right hamstring on Oct. 23, in Detroit's second game of the season. Cade Cunningham is out with knee soreness, and Detroit beat Orlando 104–86 without him.
headlines.whyItMatters: Detroit are 11–6 and fourth in the East. Duren's return adds size back to a team that has been short-handed.

headlines.title: Nets lose fifth straight
headlines.summary: The Nets have dropped five straight, their longest losing streak of the season. They have allowed a league-worst 72.2 points per first half during the streak, with early defensive collapses the main issue. Nolan Traore is out with a right hamstring strain.
headlines.whyItMatters: Brooklyn are 3–13 and 14th in the East. The early defensive problems need fixing quickly if they want to get back into the race.

headlines.title: Kevin Porter Jr. in talks with Nuggets and Magic
headlines.summary: Free agent guard Kevin Porter Jr., 26, is in talks with Denver and Orlando, according to The Stein Line's Jake Fischer. He has met with both teams, including a visit with the Magic on Monday. He continues to lean towards staying in the NBA.
headlines.whyItMatters: Denver are 10–5 and sixth in the West, and Orlando are 7–10 and eighth in the East. Either team could use a guard as the season heads into its middle stretch.
